quarterly_data.quarter: Supermicro press release: Supermicro Brings NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer Solutions to (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supermicro is now working with Nokia to deploy AI-RAN from distributed cell sites to centralized network hubs, combining Nokia's RAN technology and software with the NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (ARC) platform on Supermicro infrastructure. Systems: the dual-node ARC-Pro (an NVIDIA Grace C1 CPU and an RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPU per node in a 429 mm chassis, up to 1.6 PFLOPS of FP4), the 1U short-depth ARC-Compact, the ARC MGX 2U (dual NVIDIA Vera CPUs or dual x86 with two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs) and the air-cooled ARC MGX 4U (up to eight RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs and up to 6 TB of DDR5). Supermicro's servers for NVIDIA ARC are generally available now; the ARC MGX 2U with dual Vera will be available later this year, and the 2U ARC-Pro is planned for customer testing later this year with general availability in the first half of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 1.6 PFLOPS FP4 (ARC-Pro); ARC servers generally available now; ARC-Pro GA in the first half of 2027
